request: Mission: prove the missing-tail half of the fix is done in the pinned release with measurements only; fix any gap through the one-command builder; add a ratchet that fails if the tail regresses.
findings: Tail chain was already correct: 7/7 joints, tail_0 under pelvis, chain order intact, rest within 0.0 units and 1.264 degrees of the model bind.
Tail geometry was already correct: 3064 weighted hits across 1076 vertices of mesh shiv_tail15, 16 RenderMeshFile entries with the tail mesh declared, packed model md5 identical to the base build.
The tail never moved: every tail channel in ten sampled shipped clips had spread 0.0 (worst 4e-06). dmx_tail_append.py wrote the tail rest into the channels, so the tail was frozen at one pose.
68 of 206 clips carry no tail channels at all (7 or 0, never partial): 24 compiler-generated non_additive documents and 44 aim/lean matrix cells whose bodies are the game's own 140-joint data.
fixes: Added tools/tail_motion_apply.py, which composes the project's authored tail curve onto each clip's tail channels as a delta from its first frame, resampled to the clip time base, leaving body channels untouched.
Rewrote all 206 clip DMX and compiled 182 with 0 failures (24 non_additive skipped).
Rebuilt through tools/shiv_release_build.py: artifacts/oldviper/shiv_tail_driven.vpk, sha256 ced6d957, 95,889,143 bytes, 267 files, skeleton 1f92a022 unchanged; installed as pak97_dir.vpk.
Added tools/tail_release_audit.py (chain, rest, geometry, clip spread) and three gate checks that fail if the chain, its geometry or its drive disappears.
evidence: After the fix 25/25 sampled clips that carry tail channels move the tail; spreads 0.12-1.27.
installed pak97_dir.vpk sha256 equals the pinned artifact.
limits: 44 aim/lean cells and 24 non_additive documents still hold the tail at rest by construction; they are the documented matrix trade, not a regression.
The authored tail curve is one clip reused across all clips, so the tail motion is not per-clip animation; that is an artistic call for the owner.
Whether it looks right in the game needs the game launched; no visual claim is made here.
